NBP0505.title: Raw towed Sidescan Sonar Data (XTF format) along the Chilean Inland Passage Fjord during the Nathaniel B. Palmer expedition NBP0505 (2005)
NBP0505.abstract: Derived SSS ping-level products (CSV, segment index, previews, local stitched products) created with the sss_pipeline reference implementation from raw data collected during the NBP0505 expedition and archived at MGDS.

NBP1001.title: Raw towed Sidescan Sonar Data (XTF format) from the Antarctic Larsen Ice Shelf acquired during the Nathaniel B. Palmer expedition NBP1001 (2010)
NBP1001.abstract: Derived SSS products created with the sss_pipeline reference implementation from an MGDS-archived NBP1001 snippet.
